evidence.incomplete_fix_quote: The fix for CVE-2026-27568 introduced a custom ParsedownSafeWithLinks class that sanitizes raw HTML and tags (inlineMarkup -> sanitizeATag scheme whitelist) but explicitly disables Parsedown's safeMode. Markdown link syntax [text](javascript:alert(1)) is processed by Parsedown's core inlineLink() method, which does not go through sanitizeATag; with safeMode disabled Parsedown's own javascript: URI filtering is also inactive, so [x](javascript:...) still yields a live . Fixed in commit 3ae02fa240939dbefc5949d64f05790fd25d728d by overriding inlineLink() to apply the same whitelist. (Incomplete fix for CVE-2026-27568.)
